svg.text: Proposed synthesis of the requested thiol metabolite scaffold
Protected-thiol route; stereochemistry shown exactly as encoded in the supplied SMILES
α-amino ester configuration retained in product notation

text.tspan: Note: the supplied target SMILES specifies the α-amino-ester stereocenter only; the thiol-bearing C4 center and exocyclic alkene E/Z geometry remain unspecified.
SAc = thioacetate; AcSH = thioacetic acid. This is a proposed route and requires experimental optimization and stereoisomer separation where applicable.
